immutability_rule: PLAN.json bytes at the frozen commit are the only admissible Unit 002-M scoring specification. Any change to mutation operators, seeds, expected outcomes, metrics, or promotion rule after this freeze requires a new versioned experiment and may not replace this frozen matrix.
implementation_rule: Post-freeze code may implement and validate the frozen plan, expose diagnostics, and fix implementation defects that do not change the plan. It may not delete a failing mutation, weaken a predicate, or add an outcome-dependent exception.
result_rule: The first valid execution whose runner verifies this freeze and completes all predeclared matrix cells is the canonical Unit 002-M control result. Failed infrastructure attempts before a complete valid matrix are retained as diagnostics and never silently relabeled as the canonical result.
